summary: testrrrd postinstall and on-require beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: testrrrd@1.0.0 is a no-op shim whose only functional behavior is a callback beacon. The package.json postinstall hook runs `node beacon.cjs`, and index.js re-fires the same beacon on require. beacon.cjs POSTs the package name, `os.hostname()`, the install path (`__dirname`), the current working directory, and the Node.js version to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc` over plain HTTP. The destination is not configurable and no consent is obtained; a source comment labels the beacon as 'build-provenance' as a cover story. index.js otherwise exports a Proxy that returns a noop for every property, consistent with a dependency-confusion / typosquat proof-of-concept whose purpose is to confirm installation on target machines.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
